headline: Snowman Logistics receives Rs 2.06 crore income tax demand for FY24
hook: Tax demand adds cash flow pressure
summary: Snowman Logistics has been served an income tax demand of Rs 2.06 crore for the financial year 2024. The company stated that it plans to challenge the penalty order before the appropriate appellate authorities. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this unexpected tax liability creates a minor cash outflow risk. The outcome of the appeal will determine if the provision needs to be fully absorbed by the company.
whats_next: Appeal filing before tax appellate authorities
why_it_matters: Tax penalty creates temporary cash outflow for the logistics firm.
winners_losers: Tax authorities gain / Snowman Logistics hurt
